name: vmodal-incident
description: Find road incidents in VModal dashcam footage (near-miss, collision, red-light running, pedestrian or cyclist conflict, unsafe lane change), rebuild each one second by second from the real frames, and write an incident report with a timeline, a contact sheet and a confidence level per step. Use when the user asks what happened, asks for incidents, near-misses, crashes or dangerous moments, or wants an incident report, e.g. "Find near-misses with pedestrians. Collection: dashcam_v1" or "What incidents are in dashcam_v1?". Requires the vmodal MCP (dev branch) and the vmodal-find skill.
